name: mesh-workspace
description: Your shared knowledge graph, search and notes inside the editor.

mesh.startup.description: Opt-in, user-level read-only startup. Configure with Mesh: Configure Viewer Startup. Only absolute local executable/vault paths are accepted; workspace overrides are ignored. Existing listeners are never stopped.

mesh.viewerUrl.description: Local Mesh web viewer URL. Root URLs also try /app. Only the user-level value is used; workspace settings cannot redirect your vault requests. No index owner is started.

scripts.package: bun run build && bunx --bun @vscode/vsce@3.6.2 package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out mesh-workspace-0.2.0.vsix
